summary: Sezzle Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Sezzle Funding SPE II, LLC, entered into a $300 million senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility (upsize option of $75 million) maturing May 7, 2029. The facility bears interest at 3-month Term SOFR plus 3.86% (floor 2.00%), with a 92.5% advance rate on eligible receivables. The registrant provided a limited guaranty. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation transaction.
